title: From Chaplygin Sleigh to Torpedo: An~example of a~Cartan-Geometric View of Left-Invariant Nonholonomic Systems
summary: We discuss two models of a 3D torpedo in which the centre of mass $x$ moves only longitudinally, while the body may rotate about $x$. Although these are simple examples of left-invariant distributions on the Lie group $SE(3)$, they possess rich geometric structures. For the simplest model, we arrive at an abelian extension of a flat (3,5) path geometry, while adding tiny coupling, we obtain a non-trivial hyperbolic type codimension two CR geometry whose symmetry algebra is just $\mathfrak{se}(3)$.
